KeyVault.description: Configures the key vaults used as configuration sources.

Azure.description: Configures the Azure Key Vault configuration provider. Enabled with 'AddOrchardCoreAzureKeyVault()'. Read from the application configuration only, not per tenant. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/KeyVault.Azure/.

KeyVaultName.description: The name of the Azure Key Vault, used to build the 'https://{KeyVaultName}.vault.azure.net' vault URI. Not required when 'VaultURI' is set.

VaultURI.description: The absolute URI of the Azure Key Vault. Takes precedence over 'KeyVaultName'.

ReloadInterval.description: The number of seconds to wait between attempts at polling the Azure Key Vault for changes. Leave it unset to disable reloading.

OrchardCore_KeyVault_Azure.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_KeyVault_Azure' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:KeyVault:Azure' instead.
